context.howToRead: The repeat pattern is the count of other accounts posting the same claim, how long they took, and how much of the wording they share. A claim can travel fast in people’s own words, and that is a different thing from the same sentence forty times.
context.note: Every company, account and claim here is invented. No real platform is named, because the question is what the evidence supports rather than where it was posted.
